originality.rationale: A sharp, all-finite-polynomial limit for ordered singular values is not entailed by previously established compactness and non-Schatten properties. The 2016 full text Section 7 and 2020 weighted-space Section 6 prove qualitative non-Schatten facts, not the precise \(C_g\) coefficient or exponential counting rate. Recent 2026 theorems concern different underlying spaces. Targeted searches of equivalent representations and accessible mathematical-result claims identified no covering theorem, but priority remains best-knowledge and independent verification is outstanding.

value.rationale: Determines the sharp leading finite-rank approximation constant for every nonconstant finite Dirichlet-series symbol in a natural compact operator family, a quantitative gap left by qualitative compactness and no-Schatten results. The prime-block proof reveals a maximum-modulus (rather than phase-average) coefficient and a precise exponential singular-count exponent; a natural, reusable rate invariant beyond monomial recomputation.
